meerouladen.detail: Defeat Meerouladen after unlocking the Meerca Brothers through Defenders of Neopia. Unavailable while that system is down; excludes Heermeedjet's avatar.

meukasnot.detail: Unlock Meuka using a pet with NeoFlu or Sneezles, then beat him in single-player Battledome.

ava_mind_control.detail: Visit the 2023 April Fools Sceptic Tank event.

monsterhunting.detail: Meet the participation requirement in the Spooky Food Eating Contest event; the exact threshold is unconfirmed.

easterbunnyy17.detail: Find at least eight Festival of Neggs 2015 neggs on their individual release days.

obeliskwar_ayfb89s.detail: Claim the participation reward in the 2013 Obelisk War prize shop.

novaplushie.detail: Historical McDonald's giveaway reward: May 31, 2004 or the Australian September 29, 2005 giveaway.

dariganpteri.detail: Pet lookup: a Darigan Pteri on its exact 644th day of age. Use the guide's current eligible-pet list.

punchbag.detail: Lose a battle against Punchbag Sid with your active pet. He is available only during rare appearances.

randomevents2014.detail: Assemble the Coincidence during its original event.

tfr2010_d92f4b98fa.detail: Participation reward from The Faeries' Ruin plot, 2010–2011.

spacefaerie.detail: Unlock the Space Faerie with a qualifying merchandise item code, then beat her in single-player Battledome.

hwp_krawley.detail: Collect your Tale of Woe plot prizes.

rods_champion.detail: Historical requirement: score two correct predictions in the October 2004 staff TCG tournament, or win the Return of Dr. Sloth TCG tournament.

tcgtourney2.detail: Make predictions worth at least two points in the March 2004 staff TCG tournament.

tcg_wizard.detail: Make predictions worth at least two points in the October 2003 staff TCG tournament.

teamillusen.detail: Choose Illusen's team during the 2023 Faerie Festival.

teamjhudora.detail: Choose Jhudora's team during the 2023 Faerie Festival.

thewraithresurgence.detail: Participation reward from The Wraith Resurgence plot.

halloween_reginald_hauntedbook_avatar.detail: Collect all seven Halloween 2023 Trick-or-Treat bags.

ava_vocivus.detail: Deal damage to Vocivus during The Void Within.

volcanoReward.detail: Submit the correct Mystery Island Volcano Plot answer within the first one hundred successful entries.

ava_warlock_void.detail: Accumulate 50,000 damage against Vocivus during The Void Within.

charitycorner2017.detail: Participation reward from winter Charity Corner 2017. The exact qualifying requirement is unconfirmed.

ava_fon25_zaira.detail: Participate in the 2025 Festival of Neggs.

altador2018brightvaleavatar.detail: Reach Altador Cup rank one while representing Brightvale. Switching teams in a later year can remove this avatar.

altador2018virtupetsavatar.detail: Reach Altador Cup rank one while representing Virtupets. Switching teams in a later year can remove this avatar.

a53.detail: Submit an Assignment 53 score of at least 20,000.

aaasrevenge.detail: Submit an AAA's Revenge score of at least 1,000.

ava_hands_on_board.detail: Complete ten Faerie Fragments referrals during the May 21–June 18, 2025 Faerie Frenzy Quest.

altadorcupplayer.detail: Reach Altador Cup rank one, then play an AC game.

altadorcup_staff.detail: Participate in the Altador Cup staff tournament in 2010, 2012 or 2013.

ava_yooyu_fall.detail: Finish all five Altador Cup XX achievements.

attackoftheslorgs.detail: Submit an Attack of the Slorgs score of at least 1,000.

avatarcollector.detail: Reach the top fifty on the daily Avatar Collector leaderboard.

mathsbabaa.detail: Reach the top fifty on the daily Math's Nightmare leaderboard.

beautycontest.detail: Place in the top three of your species or overall in the Beauty Contest.

ava_best_strategist.detail: Finish three consecutive Attack on Altador games within one NST day.

betterthanyou.detail: Beat a Better Than You challenge and receive its winning Neomail.

luckystreak.detail: Win ten successive Bilge Dice games. Check whether the game is currently available.

braintree.detail: Accept a Brain Tree quest, then complete two Esophagor quests for its answers. Your NP reward sets the score. Stay in the top 50 until the daily trophy awards to earn the avatar.

capara.detail: Catch Capara cheating and finish Cheat! round one. The award is random.

captionwinner.detail: Win a Caption Contest whose issue number is divisible by one hundred.

ava_cap_contest.detail: Receive a gold-tier prize in the monthly Caption Contest.

ava_clever_strategist.detail: Enter DEFEATVOID during Attack on Altador and finish the game.

cliffhanger.detail: Finish a losing game of Cliffhanger.

ava_customisation.detail: Become a Customisation Contest finalist, then open the results page.

dice_escape.detail: Submit a Dice Escape score of at least 1,000.

ava_doglefetch.detail: After Doglefetch round five, click the central Luperus's head.

drgrumps.detail: Submit a Gourmet Club Bowls score of at least 900.

efmcdraik.detail: Reach the top fifty on the monthly Escape from Meridell Castle leaderboard.

extremepotato.detail: Submit an Extreme Potato Counter score of at least 200.

ff_matchmaker.detail: Clear all 750 Faerie Fragments levels with Neopass linked so the avatar can be redeemed.

aim_jhudora_fire.detail: Complete level 25, accept level 26, let its timer expire, then return to Jhudora. This failure awards the avatar and resets your quest level and leaderboard progress.

kissthemortog.detail: Be in Kiss the Mortog's top fifty when the daily trophies are awarded.

ava_lostindark.detail: Win a game of Lost In The Dark.

ava_food_club_smmmmm.detail: Collect 1,000,000 NP in cumulative Food Club winnings since October 15, 2025. Smaller claims across multiple bets and rounds count; a single million-NP claim is not required.

freakedkorbat.detail: Be in Korbat's Lab's top fifty when trophies are awarded.

ava_game_trophy.detail: Earn at least one hundred game trophies, then open your lookup.

godori.detail: Win 250 Godori hands within one calendar month, before the monthly reset.

hatpc.detail: Submit a Hannah and the Pirate Caves score of at least 150,000.

ava_puzzle_addict.detail: Random chance on completing a Puzzle of the Past.

kacheek06.detail: Submit an Extreme Herder score of at least 250.

kioskwocky.detail: Win any prize from a Terror Mountain scratchcard. Choose a card accepted by this kiosk; the guide lists the cards and prizes. Buying the card alone does not award the avatar.

lenny_plushie.detail: Answer a Lenny Conundrum correctly within the first 250 successful entries.

library_faerie.detail: Finish one Faerie Crossword correctly before midnight NST. The first completed puzzle awards the avatar; your completion time does not matter. The guide includes today’s answers.

mastervex.detail: Random award while playing Cellblock; the guide explains progression and eligible rounds.

ava_match_madness.detail: Finish a challenge during Kiko Match III's Match Madness event.

lottery.detail: Buy a lottery ticket, win the drawing, then return to the Lottery page to receive the avatar. The guide explains which matches qualify as a win.

ntwriter.detail: Have work published in a Neopian Times issue numbered as a multiple of fifty.

nq1erick.detail: In NeoQuest, complete Erick's qualifying gem exchange. The guide lists the Clouded Gem and wand-building routes.

bunninator.detail: Defeat a Bionic Bunny during NeoQuest II.

devilpuss.detail: Defeat a Devilpuss during NeoQuest II.

weakling.detail: Random chance after losing a NeoQuest II battle to a Plains Lupe.

petpetsitter.detail: Submit a Petpetsitter score of at least 2,500.

pickyourown.detail: Leave the farm with six items and no dung. Discard dung by clicking it in your basket before collecting your sixth item; the guide explains the route and 20-click limit.

plushieTycoon.detail: End a Plushie Tycoon month with at least 50,000 NP in the game.

ava_pandorapresents.detail: Land on the Wheel of Celebration's avatar segment while the wheel is available.

randomcontest.detail: Receive first place, second place or runner-up in a Random Contest.

sewage_surfer.detail: Reach Sewage Surfer level fifty, then quit the game at that level.

sinsishifter.detail: Reach Shapeshifter level six and visit the page linked in the guide.

sitespotlight.detail: Have your site selected as a Site Spotlight winner.

smuggleddubloon.detail: Submit a Dubloon Disaster score of at least 2,500.

taelia.detail: Complete a Snow Faerie quest for Taelia.

thatsnotrubbish.detail: Collect an eligible item: a petpet, paint brush, bottled faerie, Hidden Tower item or Apple Core. The guide lists each one. A failed pickup may show a false award notice; check your avatar preferences.

taviteatime.detail: Complete at least one Tea Time with Tavi quest on five consecutive days during The Void Within.

tonucharge.detail: Win a Battledome fight using your Darigan Tonu. The reference reports that fighting someone else's Tonu currently does not qualify.

topgamer.detail: Record scores for at least 250 different games, then open My High Scores.

ava_towerconqueror.detail: Complete Faerie Fragments Tower Mode 150 times.

bullseye.detail: Submit an Ultimate Bullseye II score of at least 100.

ava_voidworks_capsule.detail: Finish ten Voidworks puzzles with thirty seconds or more remaining on each timer.

whackedkass.detail: Submit a Kass Basher score of at least 850.

evilcoconut.detail: Open this fast link and refresh it for another throw; no Flash needed. Each visit or refresh uses one throw. Knock a coconut off its stand to earn the avatar; an explosion does not count.

mediocrity.detail: Land on 4,000 NP. Check your avatar preferences afterwards: there is no award notice.

misfortune.detail: Any space can randomly award it. Check your avatar preferences; there is no notification. This wheel can have negative effects—read the guide first.

monotony.detail: Land on the question mark and finish the spin to collect the result.

ava_monotony_tick.detail: A random chance after paying at least 100,000 NP to grease the wheel, awarded when it finishes. An expensive optional attempt; not guaranteed.

extravagance.detail: Land on the blank square. An expensive optional attempt; not guaranteed.

snowager.detail: A random award when you get blasted. Regular hibernation visits cannot award it.

geraptiku_tomb.detail: A random chance when you receive an item from the tomb.

ava_fruit_machine.detail: Match three Cheops or three Puntec fruits. Cheops became eligible on September 11, 2026.

moodyskarl.detail: Receive the result where Skarl throws you out of his castle.

jester.detail: Use this question: “What do you do if [blank] fierce Peophins [blank] has eaten too much [blank] tin of olives?” Any answer is allowed. You need the random hysterical-laughter result.

kinghagan.detail: Choose a statement and offer your wisdom to Hagan. An A+ result awards the avatar. The grade is random; the guide explains outcomes and his meal breaks.

jhudorascloud.detail: Complete Jhudora’s level 20 quest. A failed quest resets progress, and her 12-hour wait is shared with Illusen. The guide explains timers, quest levels and item requests.

illusensglade.detail: Complete Illusen’s level 20 quest. A failed quest resets progress, and her 12-hour wait is shared with Jhudora. The guide explains timers, quest levels and item requests.

forgshore.detail: Redeem all nine Forgotten Shore map pieces once to unlock access, then visit each day. The avatar is one possible daily prize.

sssidney.detail: Win any prize from a Deserted Fairground scratchcard. The guide lists the eligible cards and their prizes; buying a card alone does not award the avatar.

aishascalawag.detail: Random when you win anything at Buried Treasure, booby prize included.

tdmbgpop.detail: Random on the daily prize. Odds go up during the Winter Starlight Celebration.

ednacackle.detail: Complete a quest requesting three items for a random avatar chance. One- and two-item quests cannot award it; you can let those expire. Edna is unavailable from midnight–1am and noon–1pm NST.

luckyblumaroo.detail: Keep rolling to reach the fifth (silver) die and win its jackpot. Stopping to collect ends the run. Results are random; the guide explains each die and the daily boredom limit.

cheeseroller.detail: Buy a cheese from the game’s own seller and finish in 60 seconds or less for a random avatar chance. The guide lists valid cheese names and racing choices; no cheese guarantees a win.

pooglewinner.detail: Bet on a Poogle, watch the race, and if it wins choose Return to Main Page to collect the avatar and winnings.

aim_hauntedwoods_1.detail: Send an attached petpet adventuring, then check its status for a random avatar chance. Each fixed ten-minute block gives one chance (at :00, :10, :20, :30, :40 and :50).

deadlydice.detail: Use an active pet of level 2 or higher. Tie with Von Roo, then win at least two levels. If you play again, tie and lose, you also lose the avatar.

pet_rock.detail: Attend Sticks N Stones with the matching ticket in your inventory. Buying a ticket alone does not award the avatar.

groovychomby.detail: Attend Chomby and the Fungus Balls with the matching ticket in your inventory. Buying a ticket alone does not award the avatar.

elephantejazz.detail: Attend Jazzmosis with the matching ticket in your inventory. Buying a ticket alone does not award the avatar.

jubzambra.detail: Attend Jub Zambra and the Cobrall Charmers with the matching ticket in your inventory. Buying a ticket alone does not award the avatar.

yesboyicecream.detail: Attend Yes Boy Ice-Cream with the matching ticket in your inventory. Buying a ticket alone does not award the avatar.
